title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → AwardHonor

source_tables.description: Degree honors: one row per honor on a conferred degree (HONORS_CODE, honors date). Latin honors live here.
Honors and awards: institutional, departmental, and external awards with award code, grantor, and date received. FLAG: confirm record name for your release.

Term honors assigned by the academic standing process, stored with the career term. FLAG: record and field vary by release; many schools store dean's list as a service indicator or student group instead.
Term GPA used for dean's list decisions.

notes: Honors are directory information at many schools, but only if the school's annual FERPA notice lists them. Check FERPARestriction before publishing any honor (commencement programs, press releases, dean's list feeds).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from EMPLID + source record + honor code + date.
Resolve to HELIX Degree. Null for non-degree honors.

attribute_mappings.source: STRM on term honors / award record
attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve through term-period-xref. Null for degree honors.

Degree honors -> latin_honors or graduation_honor; term honors -> deans_list or presidents_list; award codes -> departmental_award, institutional_award, national_award, scholarship, fellowship, honor_society through a local lookup.
Institution name for internal honors; grantor for external awards.

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from award date or term

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map local honors codes to cum_laude, magna_cum_laude, summa_cum_laude; 'none' for non-Latin honors. Keep the code-to-designation lookup in one seed table.
GPA the honor was based on, when the honor is GPA-driven.

attribute_mappings.source: Award amount on PS_HONOR_AWARD_CS, if tracked
attribute_mappings.transformation: Only for awards with a cash value. Scholarships already live in FinAidAward; set scholarship_flag and don't double-count the dollars in reporting.
honor_type = national_award (Fulbright, Goldwater, Truman, and similar).
